title: 候选键求解：子集枚举 + 闭包验证
expected_output:
=== 候选键求解 (枚举子集 + 闭包验证) ===
R = ABCD
F = AB->C, C->D, D->A

全部超键 (7 个):
  AB
  BC
  BD
  ABC
  ABD
  BCD
  ABCD

候选键 (3 个):
  AB   (闭包 = ABCD)
  BC   (闭包 = ABCD)
  BD   (闭包 = ABCD)

AB   闭包=ABCD   超键       且为候选键
BC   闭包=ABCD   超键       且为候选键
AC   闭包=ACD    非超键      
BD   闭包=ABCD   超键       且为候选键

code:
# 候选键求解: 枚举所有属性子集, 用闭包验证, 再取「极小超键」
def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s))


def supers_and_candidates(attrs, fds):
    lst = sorted(attrs)
    n = len(lst)
    supers = []
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        sub = frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
        if closure(sub, fds) == set(attrs):
            supers.append(sub)
    cands = [s for s in supers if not any(o < s for o in supers)]
    key = lambda s: (len(s), fmt(s))
    return sorted(supers, key=key), sorted(cands, key=key)


print("=== 候选键求解 (枚举子集 + 闭包验证) ===")
attrs = {"A", "B", "C", "D"}
fds = [
    (frozenset("AB"), frozenset("C")),
    (frozenset("C"), frozenset("D")),
    (frozenset("D"), frozenset("A")),
]
print("R = " + fmt(attrs))
print("F = " + ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in fds))
print()
supers, cands = supers_and_candidates(attrs, fds)
print("全部超键 (%d 个):" % len(supers))
for s in supers:
    print("  " + fmt(s))
print()
print("候选键 (%d 个):" % len(cands))
for s in cands:
    print("  " + fmt(s) + "   (闭包 = " + fmt(closure(s, fds)) + ")")
print()
for name in ("AB", "BC", "AC", "BD"):
    cl = closure(frozenset(name), fds)
    tag = "超键" if cl == attrs else "非超键"
    is_cand = frozenset(name) in cands
    print("%-4s 闭包=%-6s %-8s %s" % (name, fmt(cl), tag,
                                      "且为候选键" if is_cand else ""))
print()
print("结论: 极小超键才是候选键; 候选键的任意超集都是超键但不是候选键")
